notes:
Shop POS 0.3.0 brings free and paid plans, 10 invoice designs with the amount written in words, and VAT-exempt products.

### New
- **Free plan.** A new install works straight away on the Free plan, no code needed: unlimited products, up to 200 sales a day and 3 staff logins. Receipts on Free end with a small "Powered by Shop POS" line.
- **Starter and Business plans.** Starter allows unlimited sales and up to 10 staff. Business allows unlimited staff. Paid plans have no "Powered by" line on receipts.
- **10 invoice designs.** Choose Invoice 1 to Invoice 10 in Settings: Clean, Grid, Bold title, Header band, Numbered rows, Contact strip, Mono (for black-and-white printers), Letterhead, Compact (for long orders) and Invoice and waybill (with a delivery note and "Received in good condition" signatures). Quotes and A4 sale invoices use the same designs.
- **Amount in words** on invoices and quotes, for example "One million, two hundred and eighty-five thousand, seven hundred naira only". You can switch it off in Settings.
- **Terms and conditions** and **signature lines** on invoices, set once in Settings.
- **VAT-exempt products.** In the product form, under More details, switch on "No VAT on this product". Exempt items carry no VAT on receipts, quotes and invoices, and the VAT report shows exempt sales on their own line.
- **Settings > Subscription** shows your plan, today's sales against the Free limit, staff logins against your limit, and your device code, with a button to get a code on WhatsApp.

### Improved
- **Nobody is locked out when a plan ends.** Seven days after a paid plan ends, the shop moves to the Free plan. All products, sales, customers and staff stay. Before, the shop became read-only.
- **Staff limits never delete anyone.** If a shop has more staff than its plan allows, the owner can still log in and choose who to turn off in Settings > Staff.
- **Invoices run over several pages cleanly.** The table heading repeats on each page, rows are never cut in half, and the totals stay with the last items.
- **Square corners** on every invoice design.

### Fixed
- **Expired stock is flagged before payment.** A cart line now shows "Expired batch: check before selling" when that product still has expired stock. Before, nothing showed until payment.
- **Restoring a backup keeps this computer's identity,** so a restored shop is never mistaken for another computer.

### Good to know
- Shops already activated keep their plan until its paid-until date.
- The one-click "Save PDF" on the sale screen now says "Save plain PDF". To save an invoice in your chosen design, use Print A4 and pick "Save as PDF" in the print window.
